initialExam.title: HTET 2026 (Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test)
initialExam.description: Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test for primary, TGT, and PGT level teacher recruitment in Haryana government schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching degree/diploma as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Level 1 (PRT): Child Development, Hindi, English, Math, EVS. Level 2 (TGT): Child Development, Languages, Subject. Level 3 (PGT): Subject + Pedagogy.
initialExam.examPattern: Level 1: 150 marks. Level 2: 150 marks. Level 3: 150 marks. Each 2.5 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: HTET Qualification → Haryana Government Teacher Recruitment
initialExam.jobRole: PRT, TGT, PGT in Haryana government schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: Teacher → Head Teacher → Block Education Officer → DEO.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit haryanatet.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
